svg.title: A launch file tree
svg.desc: A tree of launch files. Tag 1: the box team_launch.py, with arrows down to two boxes. Tag 2: robot_launch.py with robot:=robot2 and with_monitor:=false, with an arrow down to a dashed box, the namespace /robot2, holding the node battery_publisher. Tag 3: robot_launch.py with robot:=robot1, with an arrow down to the dashed box /robot1, holding the nodes battery_publisher and battery_monitor.
